title: Desert animals
examples: How do animals survive when it is very hot in the desert?
What do lizards eat in the desert?
Can scorpions survive in the desert?

explain.say: Today you will learn about animals that live in the desert.
Camels live in hot deserts. They can go a long time without water.
Lizards are reptiles. Many desert lizards are sandy colours, so they blend in.
Scorpions have a tail with a sting. Look at them from far away.
All these animals have ways to stay cool. They rest in the shade or dig under the sand.
Many desert animals get water from the food they eat.

faq.q: Do all desert animals need to drink water?
faq.a: Some desert animals get most of their water from their food.
asks: Where do desert animals get water?
Can they live without drinking water?

faq.q: What is the camel's hump for?
faq.a: The hump helps camels store fat. This fat gives them energy when food is scarce.
Some lizards can change colour. They do it to warm up, cool down or hide.
Scorpions can sting. Never touch one. Look from far away and tell a grown-up.
asks: What should I do near scorpions?

faq.q: Do all desert animals sleep during the day?
faq.a: Many animals rest during the hottest part of the day. They wait until it is cooler to move around.
asks: Is it always hot in the desert?

facts: Camels can go for a long time without finding water.
Many desert lizards are sandy colours that blend in.
Scorpions are nocturnal, meaning they are active at night.
Many desert animals can survive on very little food.

quiz.say: Which desert animal stores fat in its hump?
quiz.why: A camel's hump stores fat. The fat gives it energy.

wrong.0: A lizard is a small reptile with no hump.
wrong.1: A scorpion has a tail with a sting, and no hump.

quiz.say: Why are many desert lizards sandy coloured?
quiz.why: A sandy colour matches the ground. It helps the lizard hide.

wrong.0: Their colour is for hiding, so other animals find them hard to see.
wrong.2: Colour cannot keep a lizard wet.

quiz.say: When do many desert animals rest?

options.show: in the hottest part of the day
options.say: in the hottest part of the day

quiz.why: Resting in the shade at the hottest time helps them stay cool.

wrong.1: Many desert animals come out at night, when it is cooler.
wrong.2: It rarely rains in the desert.
